step.name: createServerUpdateVariables
step.title: Create variables for the versions
step.description: Retrieves the current and the new version and puts the results in variables to be used by later steps
step.instructions: Submit shell script to execute step

template.inlineTemplate:
# Get the current version currentversion_unfixed=$(iconv -t IBM037 -f utf-8 ${instance-SERVER_DIRECTORY}/EkmfWeb.properties | grep com.ibm.websphere.productVersion | sed -E 's/.*=([^\$])/\1/')
oldIFS=$IFS IFS=. set -- $currentversion_unfixed
MAJOR=$1 MINOR=$2 PATCH=$3 BUILD=$4
echo "old version major=$MAJOR minor=$MINOR patch=$PATCH build=$BUILD"
if [ ${#BUILD} -eq 1 ]; then echo "minor version is a single digit and needs a zero to be added" if [ $MAJOR -lt 2 ];then echo "The current version is a version from the EKMF Web Service:" ${currentversion} currentversion="2."$MINOR"."$PATCH."0"$BUILD echo "The version has been converted to the product version:" ${currentversion} else currentversion=$MAJOR"."$MINOR"."$PATCH."0"$BUILD fi else currentversion=$currentversion_unfixed fi
# Get the new version newversion_unfixed=$(iconv -t IBM037 -f utf-8 ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/EkmfWeb.properties | grep com.ibm.websphere.productVersion | sed -E 's/.*=([^\$])/\1/')
set -- $newversion_unfixed IFS=$oldIFS
MAJOR=$1 MINOR=$2 PATCH=$3 BUILD=$4
echo "new version major=$MAJOR minor=$MINOR patch=$PATCH build=$BUILD"
if [ ${#BUILD} -eq 1 ]; then echo "minor version is a single digit and needs a zero to be added" newversion=$MAJOR"."$MINOR"."$PATCH."0"$BUILD else newversion=$newversion_unfixed fi
echo "SERVER_VERSION ${currentversion}" >> ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.properties echo "NEW_SERVER_VERSION ${newversion}" >> ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.properties
chmod 644 ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.properties
